scope: Freeze a dated DSA Global Relay & Macro Overlay position-ceiling contract for U45 after the Hong Kong close. This layer constrains exposure only; it does not overwrite any native DSA score or create a BUY signal.

fed.fact: FOMC raised the federal funds target range by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on 2026-09-16 by a 12-0 vote; effective implementation begins 2026-09-17.

oil.note: Oil was easing intraday but remained above USD100, so the inflation/geopolitical channel is improved at the margin but not cleared.

hk_policy_transmission.fact: HKMA raised the Base Rate by 25bp to 4.25% tracking the Fed; major banks reported in Reuters kept best lending rates unchanged at that time.

US_Overnight.reason: S&P 500 and Dow fell after the hike; Nasdaq was roughly flat, so risk appetite was not a broad capitulation but remained fragile.

Rates_Bond.reason: Fed hike is confirmed, 2Y is elevated and 10Y is near 5%, keeping discount-rate pressure high.

Asia_Lead.reason: Nikkei finished modestly positive and KOSPI near flat; no broad Asia liquidation confirmation.

China_HK.reason: HSI/HSTECH fell modestly while Southbound produced a ninth consecutive net-inflow day and HIBOR showed no funding stress.

War_Commodity.reason: Brent and WTI remained above USD100, but both eased materially on the day as supply fears moderated.

Influence_Narrative.reason: The relevant high-authority signal is the actual FOMC decision, not commentary; no social-media narrative is allowed to override it without market confirmation.

HK_Capital_Tide.reason: Verified Southbound accumulation is strong and persistent, but index prices have not yet confirmed a broad risk-on regime.

regime.label: NEUTRAL_DIVERGENCE_DEFENSIVE_BIAS
regime.rationale: Confirmed Fed tightening and 5% 10Y yields prevent a high-risk allocation; oil remains an inflation risk. However, nine consecutive Southbound inflow days, low-stress HIBOR, mixed-not-collapsing Asia and falling oil argue against a Global Risk-Off 0-10% cap. A 30% ceiling keeps the account inside the Neutral-Divergence band with a defensive bias.

upshift_requires: HK price confirmation improves while verified Southbound accumulation persists
10Y yield retreats materially from ~5% or policy-tightening expectations stop rising
oil falls below the current triple-digit stress regime without a new geopolitical shock
downshift_requires_any: oil re-accelerates with yields rising and equities falling (inflationary triple-kill)
Southbound flips to sustained verified outflow and HSI/HSTECH weaken together
HKD funding stress materially increases or local liquidity buffer deteriorates
